en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an image on the left and blank space on the right. The image shows a narrow old European street bordered by tall brick buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street toward an ornate arched passageway connecting buildings above the street, crowned with statues and decorative gables. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street in Bruges.
